abstract: BACKGROUND: Testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) are a relatively common malignancy in young men. The aim of this study was to investigate the clinicopathological features and survival of young Turkish patients with TGCT. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this retrospective study, the clinical and pathological characteristics of young Turkish patients with TGCT who were monitored by the Department of Medical Oncology of a military hospital between 2008 and 2013 were investigated. Overall survival data were analyzed. RESULTS: Ninety-six patients were included in the study. The mean age was 26.4 years. Among the patients, 17.7% had seminoma and 43.8% had mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Some 46.9% were Stage I, 30.2% were Stage II, and 22.9 were Stage III. Of the patients, 83.3% received chemotherapy, 25% underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), 3.1% received radiotherapy, and 12.5% were followed-up without treatment. In addition, 18.8% of the patients were administered salvage chemotherapy due to relapse or progression. The 5-year overall survival rate was 90.2% for all patients. The 2-year overall survival rate was 100% for Stage I patients, 94% for Stage II patients, and 70.2% for Stage III patients. The difference between the survival curves of stages was statistically significant (p=0.029). CONCLUSIONS: In young Turkish patients with TGCT, good results were obtained with appropriate treatment, most receiving chemotherapy. The prognosis of the disease was good even in the advanced stage.
abstract_ja:
背景：精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)は若年男性に比較的多い悪性腫瘍である。本研究の目的は、若年トルコ人患者のTGCTにおける臨床病理学的特徴と生存を検討することである。
方法：本後方視的研究では、2008年から2013年に軍病院の腫瘍内科で診療を受けた若年トルコ人TGCT患者の臨床病理学的特徴を検討した。全生存期間を解析した。
結果：96例が研究に含まれた。平均年齢は26.4歳であった。患者の17.7%がセミノーマ、43.8%が混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍であった。46.9%が病期I、30.2%が病期II、22.9%が病期IIIであった。83.3%が化学療法を受け、25%が後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受け、3.1%が放射線療法を受け、12.5%は治療せずにフォローアップされた。18.8%が再発または進行のため救援化学療法を受けた。5年全生存率は全患者で90.2%であった。2年全生存率は病期Iで100%、病期IIで94%、病期IIIで70.2%であった。病期間の生存曲線の差は統計学的に有意であった(p=0.029)。
結論：若年トルコ人TGCT患者では、適切な治療により良好な結果が得られ、大半の患者が化学療法を受けた。進行期においても予後は良好であった。
